exposure: women with isthmocele complaining of chronic pelvic pain
women with isthmocele complaining of abnormal uterine bleeding
women with isthmocele complaining of secondary infertility
cohort: 31 women with isthmocele (residual myometrium < 5 mm) complaining of abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain, or secondary infertility
finding: Laparoscopic isthmocele repair was found to be an effective treatment for isthmocele-related symptoms, with high success rates in improving abnormal uterine bleeding, chronic pelvic pain, and secondary infertility, and these benefits persisted even after a subsequent cesarean section.
mod_finding: The benefit of laparoscopic isthmocele repair seems to persist even after a subsequent cesarean section.
